A short summary stored in the app. It separates what research supports from the organising defaults that you can change.
Eating relatively earlier in the day and keeping less food for late at night may help some people; overall evidence quality is still limited (Liu 2024, JAMA Netw Open).
In a 12-month trial, adding an 8-hour eating window to calorie restriction did not add significant weight loss (Liu 2022, NEJM). Waqtak does not impose fasting.
Eating more slowly was linked to lower energy intake in experiments (Robinson 2014). The meal timer is a flexible behavioural aid; no study makes 20 minutes a medical maximum.
Caffeine can shorten and lighten sleep; for an average coffee, the review suggests avoiding it roughly 8–9 hours before bed. Sensitivity and doses vary (Gardiner 2023).
Water, milk and sugar-free drinks including tea and coffee all count toward fluids; drinking with or after meals is generally fine (NHS).
With reflux, finishing meals about 3 hours before lying down may improve symptoms (NIDDK). A varied diet with less free sugar is recommended (WHO).
First meal about 1 hour after waking; next meals about 4–5 hours apart when the day allows.
The last meal ends about 2 hours before sleep (about 3 hours with the reflux option).
Meal timers: breakfast 20, lunch 25, dinner 20 minutes — product defaults, not ideal durations.
Drink reminders every 90 minutes while awake, suggesting water first; there is no medical fluid formula in the app.
There is no single best breakfast or lunch time for everyone, so every time can be changed.

Waqtak does not diagnose, does not calculate calories or personal medical needs, and does not promise weight loss. Eat or drink whenever you are hungry or thirsty. If you have a medical condition, follow your care team.

Waqtak has no internet permission, no account, no ads, no analytics and no cloud backup. Your schedule and records are stored only on this device. You can export or import a file through the system file picker, and delete the history or all data at any time in Settings. The app does not request contacts, location or microphone.
Links are optional and open in your browser; the app works without them.
